title: cyankeys
description: Move items with highly customizable hotkeys!
body:
# cyankeys

A client-side macro keybind mod, focused on making repeated inventory and action workflows faster.

Create named keybinds, assign them to keyboard or mouse inputs, and build small macro sequences for common tasks like moving items, dropping items, running client commands, or sending chat messages.

## Features

- Create custom macro keybinds in-game
- Bind macros to keyboard keys or mouse buttons
- Transfer items between player inventory and containers
- Select items by item type, slot, or hotbar slot
- Drop selected items with a keybind
- Run client commands or send chat messages
- Choose trigger behavior like once, repeat, or toggle repeat
- Configure through ModMenu, with fallback keybinds for settings and enable/disable

## Inventory Support

Supports common container layouts such as player inventory, chests, hoppers, droppers, furnaces, shulker boxes, crafting stations, and configurable custom grids.

Inventory actions are performed through normal screen-handler click operations on supported platforms instead of directly editing the client inventory.
